residual_findings.title: React Router: open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (CVE-2025-68470 bypass)
residual_findings.reason: Requires an attacker-controlled string with a leading backslash to reach a <Link to> or navigate() target. Every dynamic target in frontend/src is either a path this application wrote into history state (checked for the /account/ prefix before use), a value from a fixed set returned by destinationForSession(), or a report/dashboard link built server-side in report_service.py as a literal '/...' path with enum values in the query string. No URL query parameter, form field or API string is ever passed to a navigation.

residual_findings.title: React Router: arbitrary constructor injection via deserializeErrors() in SSR hydration
residual_findings.reason: Requires server-side rendering with a data router and hydrateRoot. main.jsx uses createRoot; there is no StaticRouter, createBrowserRouter, RouterProvider or hydrateRoot anywhere in frontend/src.

blank_page_observation.note: Three consecutive complete suites at this commit passed, 259 each, retries 0, one worker. Earlier in the phase, at an intermediate commit, two instances of the same class were seen: once as staffAccessibility.spec.js failing to find a report heading that was there on every other run, and once as the Vite dev server answering ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED mid-run with nothing in its log. blank_page_observation.recurrence_at_rc_uat_5: One run during the fix pack failed once waiting for the staff applications heading inside an activation helper, and passed in every other run; the same unexplained class. Not classified as fixed.
blank_page_observation.recurrence_at_rc_uat_21: Three full Playwright runs on the default port each lost one different account spec to ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on a Vite module request (blank page); each spec passed alone, and the full run on port 5473 passed 325. Recorded by the build as an environment flake; the same unexplained class. Not classified as fixed.
blank_page_observation.resolution_at_rc_uat_22: The harness started Vite without --host, so on Windows it listened on ::1 only, while Chromium resolves localhost itself and, when its periodic IPv6 probe says no, connects over IPv4 -- refused, one module missing, a blank page, a different spec each run. run_e2e.mjs now binds both servers to the literal 127.0.0.1 and gives the browser that origin; diagnostics.js probes the host of E2E_BASE_URL; no name is resolved in a run. After the fix two full runs in a row on the default port 5173 passed 326 each, no failure, no retry. The earlier non-connection instances (RC-UAT-4, RC-UAT-5) are not separately explained; a recurrence would reopen this.
